title: Treasury threatens sanctions after White House claims Moonshot distilled Anthropic’s Fable
slides: Did Moonshot steal Anthropic's secret model Fable?
Treasury now threatens sanctions over the alleged theft.
The White House claims Fable was distilled without permission.
Your compliance team must audit all model training data immediately.
One wrong dataset could bring federal penalties tomorrow.
thread_text:
1. Who stole Fable?

Moonshot allegedly lifted Anthropic’s secret model Fable. Treasury just threatened sanctions.

2. White House stepped in.

The White House claims distillation happened without permission. That makes it a federal matter.

3. Your data is the risk.

One wrong training dataset can trigger federal penalties. Compliance teams must audit everything now.

4. Sanctions are real.

Treasury’s threat isn’t symbolic. If the theft is proven, fines could hit tomorrow.

5. Audit your datasets today.

Take one training dataset your team uses and trace its origin. If you can’t prove it’s clean, you have work to do.
